exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. emergency cesarean section)
outcome: Umbilical cord Nucleated Red Blood Cell (NRBC) count
finding: Emergency cesarean section was associated with a three-fold increase in the mean umbilical cord NRBC count compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section increased the mean of umbilical cord NRBC by three times, compared to that of normal delivery.
gest_age: Preterm (mean gestational age at birth: 30.75 weeks)
